text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that parking be prohibited at all times, on the south side of Meteor Drive, between Carlingview Drive and Galaxy Boulevard. Currently several small sections have no parking regulations. However, additional businesses have raised concerns that parked vehicles are restricting access to their loading docks. Therefore, it is proposed that parking be prohibited on the entire south side ensure access to area businesses by large vehicles.

The Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the south side of Meteor Drive, between Carlingview Drive and a point 71 metres east of Carlingview Drive. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the south side of Meteor Drive, between a point 122 metres east of Carlingview Drive and a point 24 metres further east. 3. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the south side of Meteor Drive, between a point 158 metres east of Carlingview Drive and a point 24 metres further east. 4. Prohibited parking at all times on the south side of Meteor Drive, between Carlingview Drive and Galaxy Boulevard.
